title: Reduced Order Modeling for Tsunami Forecasting with Bayesian Hierarchical Pooling
abstract: arXiv:2512.19804v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Reduced-order models (ROMs) can represent spatiotemporal processes in significantly fewer dimensions and can often be solved many orders of magnitude faster than their governing partial differential equations (PDEs). For example, proper orthogonal decomposition yields a ROM in which the state is represented as a low-dimensional linear combination of fixed spatial modes and time-dependent coefficients, but this representation remains constrained by the process used to construct the basis. In this work, we explore a new type of ROM that is not restricted to a single fixed coefficient trajectory. Specifically, we consider a corrected Galerkin-projection ROM, formulated as an initial value problem that encodes the physics of the governing PDEs and is calibrated through operator corrections to more accurately reproduce the coefficient dynamics. translated_title: 基于贝叶斯分层池化的海啸预报降阶建模
translated_abstract: 降阶模型（ROMs）能以显著更少的维度表示时空过程，并且通常比其控制偏微分方程（PDEs）的求解速度快多个数量级。例如，本征正交分解生成一种ROM，其中状态表示为固定空间模态和随时间变化系数的低维线性组合，但这种表示仍受限于构建基函数的过程。在本工作中，我们探索了一种新型ROM，它不局限于单一固定系数轨迹。具体而言，我们考虑了一种修正的Galerkin投影ROM，将其表述为一个初值问题，该问题编码了控制PDE的物理特性，并通过算子修正进行校准，以更准确地再现系数动态。通过将此修正降阶模型与贝叶斯分层池化框架相结合，我们实现了更灵活且稳健的海啸预报。
tldr: 本文提出了一种结合修正Galerkin投影降阶模型与贝叶斯分层池化的新方法，突破了传统ROM固定系数轨迹的限制，从而显著提升海啸预报的准确性和鲁棒性。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces a novel approach combining a corrected Galerkin-projection reduced-order model with Bayesian hierarchical pooling, overcoming the limitation of fixed coefficient trajectories in traditional ROMs to significantly enhance tsunami forecasting accuracy and robustness.
